items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Can you tell me anything else that Contrell might have taught you?

ctx.x: Well, I used to take Augusta Bell and play the lead from the line, I'd have played them jazz pieces. Well, that's right. I'd read them violin parts. They had seven octaves, but Bell only got two and a half, I used to transport it down, yeah. Keep the ledger line, yeah. One time I was about to only read a drum to head you after Contrell died. I mean, a real one, you know, playing anything, you see.
